notes: Nazarene congregation on S Pantano Rd. Address 410 S. Pantano Rd., Tucson 85710 confirmed in the site footer; coordinates left as 'approximate' from the earlier pass (worth re-running tools/geocode.py). The site's 'Meet our staff' block lists Rev. Darrin Milgrim (Lead Pastor), Rev. Albert Hughes (Associate Pastor / Hospice Chaplain - this is the 'Pastor Albert' from the earlier search snippet), Eddie Laub (Youth Pastor / Tech Coordinator), Missy Canfield (Office Manager / Worship Coordinator) and Stephen & Maya Canfield (Young Adult Leaders). Only Milgrim and Hughes are recorded as pastors; whether Hughes preaches regularly is NOT confirmed, so check the sermon videos before attributing anything to him. CAUTION FOR THE NEXT AGENT: several unrelated churches share this name. mvcnlife.org / mvcnaz.org is Mountain View Church of the Nazarene in TUMWATER, WASHINGTON (lead pastors Chad and Stephanie Johnson) - do not use its staff list, and do not use the YouTube channel @MtnViewWebMaster (UCQ8R3uXIf913nBYJ40X8BoA), which links to mvcnaz.org. The channel recorded here (UC-rHoyX_C0RfO-wgxVxvJnA) is the right one: its own description reads 'Mountain View Church of the Nazarene, in Tucson AZ'. Note the church's site is HTTP only - https://www.mvnaz.org returns a TLS certificate name mismatch. The site itself links only Facebook and Instagram, no sermon page; upload cadence on the YouTube channel was not verified.
